story_overview: Legendary motorcycle racer Luca, known as 'The Doctor', navigates a chaotic race season fraught with peril. He endures multiple high-speed crashes, some involving his rival Javier, leading to dramatic tumbles and wrecked machinery. The story culminates with Luca in the pit box, revealing a personal token hidden beneath his racing suit.
